newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers slide, other areas slow to follow.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers slide, other areas slow to follow.

text.p: ARA bunker prices slid on Monday, but bunkers in other areas were slow to fall, and demand in most areas was patchy, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst bunkers were about $7 a tonne weaker, with offers at around $114 fob. The fall left only thin demand. Dealers said most buyers were, as expected, waiting for prices to bottom out.
French and Italian fuel oil bunkers came off by about $1 a tonne. Dealers said they expected a significant fall later this week. Buyers, aware of this, were dormant.
However, Spanish bunkers were $1 a tonne stronger with a reasonable number of enquiries.
"There's one major back in the market in the south," one dealer said.
Fujairah bunkers held up despite the crude crash due to the resilience of the fuel oil cargo market.
Durban prices ticked up $1, but the supply problems that have afflicted the market for the past two weeks were over, dealers said.
